revisions.title: Anokhi Women’s Pure Cotton Traditional Printed Anarkali Kurta Set with Dupatta (Navy Blue, Festive Edition)
revisions.description: Bring a touch of everyday elegance to your wardrobe with this Anokhi printed Anarkali kurta. The flowing navy blue silhouette pairs a traditional floral print with the comfort of breathable cotton. Style it with the matching dupatta for a family gathering, a festive celebration, or a relaxed day out. Available in a range of sizes. Please check the size guide before ordering.

Gentle hand wash recommended. Wash dark colours separately.
